answer.rationale: Roll out SMB signup/onboarding simplification rather than matching the competitor with promotional pricing. Simplification has a confirmed durable activation lift in SMB, and shorter onboarding improves time-to-value. Targeted discounting drove acquisition and near-term qualified revenue but materially reduced 30-day retention and failed to survive renewal, making it unsuitable for the long-term qualified-revenue objective. The price-cut context may limit the magnitude of the onboarding response, so monitor SMB activation, qualified revenue, and retention closely.
